command:
# G2 smoke test (docs/g2.md): every g2 regime, state and instrument once on Standard-8 and the
# SRR062634 reads, plus the CRT stage and ETag check on RODA v205's small files. Not a
# measurement; it proves scripts/g2-instance.sh, scripts/g2.sh and scripts/lib/g2run.py on
# Graviton (perf control fifo, /proc sampler, diskstats, tmpfs) before the big runs.
# Code: the launch commit, cloned from GitHub. Every setup step fails fast.
W=$HOME/ak2; mkdir -p "$W"
SHA=${AK2_RUN_ID##*-}
B=cookbook-942542972736-us-west-2; DATA=aws-kraken2/data
fail() { ak2_say "ERROR: $*"; exit 1; }
G2_DEADLINE=$(( $(date +%s) + 40 * 60 )); export G2_DEADLINE

ak2_phase setup
sudo -n dnf install -y -q git > "$W/dnf0.log" 2>&1 || fail "dnf git failed"
git clone -q https://github.com/scttfrdmn/aws-kraken2.git "$W/repo" || fail "clone failed"
git -C "$W/repo" checkout -q "$SHA" || fail "checkout $SHA failed"
cd "$W/repo" || fail "no repo"
. scripts/g2-instance.sh
g2i_setup
g2i_nvme

ak2_phase fetch
DB=$G2_NVME/db/k2_standard_08_GB_20260626; RD=$G2_NVME/reads
g2i_stage_ours "$DB" "$B" "$DATA" k2_standard_08_GB_20260626
g2i_stage_reads "$RD" "$B" "$DATA" SRR062634_200000
g2i_subset "$RD" SRR062634_200000 50000 SRR062634_50000
g2i_awscfg 12Gb/s
g2i_stage_roda "$G2_NVME/roda" opts.k2d taxo.k2d
g2i_gzip_rate "$RD/SRR062634_200000_1.fq.gz"

ak2_phase build
g2i_build

G2_PLAN=scripts/g2/smoke.plan G2_DB=$DB G2_READS=$RD G2_WORK=$G2_NVME/work G2_LABEL=smoke G2_RUNG_TIMEOUT=300
export G2_PLAN G2_DB G2_READS G2_WORK G2_LABEL G2_RUNG_TIMEOUT
. scripts/g2.sh
RC1=$?
ak2_say "g2 smoke rc=$RC1"
ak2_phase ramdb
g2i_ramdb "$DB" /mnt/ram 12G "$(aws s3api head-object --bucket "$B" --key "$DATA/k2_standard_08_GB_20260626/hash.k2d" --query ETag --output text | tr -d '"')"
ak2_req HeadObject 1 "$B"
G2_PLAN=scripts/g2/smoke-ram.plan G2_RAMDB=/mnt/ram G2_LABEL=smoke-ram
export G2_PLAN G2_RAMDB G2_LABEL
. scripts/g2.sh
RC2=$?
ak2_say "g2 smoke-ram rc=$RC2"
ak2_phase push
[ "$RC1" = 0 ] && [ "$RC2" = 0 ] || exit 1
exit 0
